description: START HERE. Use when you need a tool, MCP server, agent or skill for a task (e.g. query Postgres, automate a browser, take payments). Returns the top 3 verified, installable options with a one-line install, in about 3 KB. Example: {"task":"query a Postgres database"}

client.description: Optional: your client (claude, cursor, chatgpt, hermes) for a client-specific install snippet.

fields.description: Only these keys of the full record, e.g. ["install","source"].

task.description: The task in plain words, e.g. "query a Postgres database".

verbose.description: Full records (lead, source, verification, all snippets).

name: find_tool_for_task
title: Find a verified tool for a task
